title: The binary hook that installs udev for buildd builds  now fails (because the hook does not mount /proc). But using a binary hook to install a package that ends up in every artifact is obtuse; so just add udev to the list of packages in auto/config and delete the hook (and the redundant installation of udev in 52-linux-virtual-image.binary). (LP: #2165421)
description:
Backport of 5d43ef14befe061861d6ed67946a20891279fc90 from the development series to ubuntu/resolute.

The fix deletes the hook, seeds udev via add_package install udev in auto/config so it is installed in the chroot stage where proc is mounted, and drops the udev from 52-linux-virtual-image.binary.

Local testing info:
Tested by running an Ubuntu build for a buildd image using bartender locally which was successful

Related info:
LP: #2165421, MP #511182
commit_message: The binary hook that installs udev for buildd builds  now fails (because the hook does not mount /proc). But using a binary hook to install a package that ends up in every artifact is obtuse; so just add udev to the list of packages in auto/config and delete the hook (and the redundant installation of udev in 52-linux-virtual-image.binary). (LP: #2165421)

+  * The binary hook that installs udev for buildd builds  now fails (because
+    the hook does not mount /proc). But using a binary hook to install a
+    package that ends up in every artifact is obtuse; so just add udev to the
+    list of packages in auto/config and delete the hook (and the redundant

 livecd-rootfs (26.04.36) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Update SEEDMIRROR default to use static-reports.u.c instead of
diff --git a/live-build/auto/config b/live-build/auto/config
index 66ea075..7ee071e 100755
--- a/live-build/auto/config
+++ b/live-build/auto/config
@@ -1303,6 +1303,9 @@ case $SUBPROJECT in
 		add_package install gpg-agent
 		add_package install fakeroot
 		add_package install build-essential
+		# Brought in by ubuntu-cloud-minimal in regular lxd image
+		# builds, needed for network device configuration.
+		add_package install udev
 		# Needed for LXD-based builds.
 		add_package install init
 		# Needed for bootable buildd systems which don't get injected
diff --git a/live-build/buildd/hooks/03-network.binary b/live-build/buildd/hooks/03-network.binary
deleted file mode 100755
index 9d841bf..0000000
--- a/live-build/buildd/hooks/03-network.binary
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,12 +0,0 @@
-#!/bin/bash -eux
-
-. config/functions
-
-chroot_dir=chroot
-
-# Networking interface configuration relies udev.
-# In normal LXD images, it's a transitive depends of ubuntu-cloud-minimal
-# seed, which isn't present in buildd images.
-chroot "$chroot_dir"  apt-get -y update
-env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$chroot_dir"  apt-get -y install udev
-chroot "$chroot_dir"  apt-get -y clean
diff --git a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
index b5a00db..f1ed534 100755
--- a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
+++ b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@ env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$mount_d" apt-get \
 # Install dependencies
 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$mount_d" apt-get \
     install -y lsb-release locales dracut busybox-initramfs \
-               udev dbus netplan.io cloud-init openssh-server sudo snapd \
+               dbus netplan.io cloud-init openssh-server sudo snapd \
                lxd-agent-loader
 
 # Install a kernel
